construction_intent.continuous_shell: one connected low-density cage; form the two feet and U opening from the shell's topology rather than separate cylinder/cube assemblies
construction_intent.surface_plan: No SubD, crease, or bevel until the shell passes front, side, and isometric primary-cage review. Then use edge loops/creases for the rollover and foot corners; use a restrained weighted bevel only if the reference shows a genuine radius.
construction_intent.known_limits: Pixel-derived local box targets guide repair only and do not substitute for visual acceptance. The display's exact seven-segment glyph geometry is out of primary-cage scope.
